meta.name: The Kominsky Method
meta.description:
Acting coach Sandy Kominsky and best friend Norman Newlander keep each other laughing as they navigate the ups and downs of getting older.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 16 Nov 2018 · United States of America · Language: English
Studio: Chuck Lorre Productions, Warner Bros. Television · Network: Netflix

Not complete. On your server: S1 7/8 (missing E8) | S2 8/8 | S3 6/6

On your server — Audio: English

videos.title: Chapter 1. An Actor Avoids
videos.overview: As Sandy gets to know a new student better, he puts off visiting an old friend who wants to see him. Norman copes with a difficult issue at home.

videos.title: Chapter 2. An Agent Grieves
videos.overview: Sandy helps Norman organize an event with complicated arrangements and invites Lisa on an unusual date. Norman is a hit with Sandy's class.

videos.title: Chapter 3. A Prostate Enlarges
videos.overview: While Sandy contends with a worsening prostate problem and conflict between his students, Norman deals with his troubled daughter, Phoebe.

videos.title: Chapter 4. A Kegel Squeaks
videos.overview: Sandy and Norman turn to each other for support as Sandy waits for his test results and tension between Norman and Phoebe ramps up.

videos.title: Chapter 5. An Agent Crowns
videos.overview: Norman worries he may have made the wrong decision about Phoebe. Sandy wants to take his relationship with Lisa to the next level.

videos.title: Chapter 6. A Daughter Detoxes
videos.overview: Norman and Sandy drive Phoebe to rehab, then spend the night at a casino. Sandy faces a financial quandary and learns he's angered Lisa.

videos.title: Chapter 7. A String Is Attached
videos.overview: Norman contemplates a financial arrangement with Sandy. Sandy tries to smooth things over with Lisa. Mindy helps her father with his tax situation.

videos.title: Chapter 9. An Actor Forgets
videos.overview: Sandy has concerns about the man Mindy's dating. Norman starts seeing an old flame. Sandy tries to give his class a dose of truth about the acting life.

videos.title: Chapter 10. An Old Flame, an Old Wick
videos.overview: Norman and Madelyn get closer as they spend time together in Santa Barbara. When Sandy meets Mindy's boyfriend, he discovers they have a lot in common.

videos.title: Chapter 11. An Odd Couple Occurs
videos.overview: Mindy's not thrilled with her dad and boyfriend's growing friendship. Norman's daughter leaves rehab, returning home while Madelyn is visiting.

videos.title: Chapter 12. A Libido Sits in the Fridge
videos.overview: Interactions with two women have Sandy contemplating his changing libido. Norman tries to reconcile with both Phoebe and Madelyn.

videos.title: Chapter 13. A Shenckman Equivocates
videos.overview: Sandy urges Norman to make a grand gesture for Madelyn. After Martin experiences a medical episode, Sandy decides to have a complete checkup.

videos.title: Chapter 14. A Secret Leaks, a Teacher Speaks
videos.overview: Despite Norman's prodding, Sandy remains reluctant to share some important news with Mindy. Norman and Madelyn come to an understanding.

videos.title: Chapter 15. A Hand Job Is Forgiven
videos.overview: An accident forces Sandy to come clean with Mindy. After visiting Eileen's grave, Phoebe tries to make amends with Norman, but it doesn't go well.

videos.title: Chapter 16. A Thetan Arrives
videos.overview: As Norman contemplates retiring, an unexpected visitor has him considering his spiritual life. Sandy dislikes changes Mindy is making at the studio.

videos.title: Chapter 17. In all the old familiar places
videos.overview: After Norman passes away, his loved ones share some uncomfortable memories at his funeral, and Sandy reminisces about their long friendship.

videos.title: Chapter 18. You only give me your funny paper
videos.overview: Sandy receives both a surprise inheritance and a giant headache as executor of Norman's estate. Mindy begins seeing Martin in a new light.

videos.title: Chapter 19. And it's getting more and more absurd
videos.overview: Angry about Sandy's constraints on their money, Phoebe, Robbie, Mindy — and Mindy's mom, Roz — confront him. Sandy and Martin have a falling out.

videos.title: Chapter 20. The round toes, of the high shoes
videos.overview: A famous actor comes to Sandy's class and creates a stir. Sandy and Roz find themselves getting along. An unexpected offer materializes for Sandy.

videos.title: Chapter 21. Near, far, wherever you are
videos.overview: Phoebe and Robbie continue to try to persuade Sandy to release more of their inheritance money. Sandy begins working on a new acting role.

videos.title: Chapter 22. The fundamental things apply
videos.overview: Everyone gathers for a heartfelt wedding. And as time moves forward, schemes fall apart and dreams come true.
